messages.subject: Modification Indices in Genomic SEM?
parts:
Hello!  

In lavaan, we can check for modification indices to know what (theoretically sound) residual correlations to add between observed variables to improve model fit. (https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/modindices.html) 

Is there a way of doing this in genomic SEM ? 

My CFI is good but the SRMR of my model is quite high (0.13). 

Best, 

Camille Williams
